title: A sarod maestro and his two sons recorded an album with the Dalai Lama. It won a Grammy.

sources.text: Rayfield Allied - Grammy Win for 'Meditations', a collaboration between Amjad Ali Khan and sons, and His Holiness the Dalai Lama
ANI News - Dalai Lama receives his Grammy Award for audiobook 'Meditations' at Dharamshala residence

caption:
A sarod maestro and his two sons recorded an album with the Dalai Lama. It won a Grammy.

The winning album, 'Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama,' paired the Dalai Lama's spoken reflections with the Khan family's sarod - a classical Indian stringed instrument - across a genre category built for words, not usually music.

Amjad Ali Khan personally presented the Dalai Lama with his Grammy at his Dharamshala residence in June 2026 - closing the loop on a collaboration that crossed three generations of one Indian musical family and a Tibetan spiritual leader.

A sarod lineage built over three generations found a global audience by collaborating outward, not performing in isolation - a model for how Indian classical art keeps finding new rooms to fill.
